explain: S1 is the A4.1 regression written as a fixture. Two interfaces are tested separately. compile_source: S1 is unsupported (existential head), the source and its diagnostic are preserved, no clause is produced from S1, and every query of a source that holds S1 is unsupported (A3.1). The lower-level situation-insertion and Skolemization step: the `inspection` field of S1 gives the expected witness dependency, sk(S) in the base and sk(S,X) in two_argument_witness; situations are bound before Skolemization. without_s1 is the separately materialized source on which Q1 and Q2 are the existential-goal expectations of A3.1 and A3.3.
notes: Formal-only because the S1 English is not a sentence a prompt should be asked to produce; the compiler task consumes the Stage-2 form directly. Amended 2026-09-11 (review R3, R5). Amended 2026-09-20 (re-review RR5: witness patterns moved to `inspection`).
